PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Diodes ● P-N Junction diodes and biasing. ● P-N Junction characteristics ● Types and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Physics of wind formation 4.2 Introduction to Rockets Page 12 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
